parameters.content:
## Safe by default
Imported as-is this workflow makes **zero network calls**.

- `SANDBOX_MODE=true` → mock fixture only
- `DRY_RUN=true` → no writes
- `PACING_UPDATES_ENABLED=false` → preview only
- `SEND_SLACK_ALERTS=false`

Live writes need all four flipped, a real `OUTBOUND_API_KEY`, a non-placeholder base URL, valid config, and an untripped circuit breaker.

## Pacing engine
Mailbox health score → campaign tier → step velocity index → proposed gap.

Guardrails: min/max delay, max change per run, no compression when health ≠ HEALTHY, unsubscribe guard, per-run campaign cap, global circuit breaker.

## Live write path
`Split Pacing Payloads` re-checks every safety flag and throws if any disagree.

One POST per campaign, 1.5s apart, with an `Idempotency-Key` header.

## Alerts & audit
Slack Block Kit + generic JSON webhook. Both are blocked in sandbox and filtered by `ALERT_MIN_SEVERITY`.

The final node emits one audit record per run — send it to your log store.
